source_file: docs/英一小作文/2021英一小作文.md
relationship: 同侪好友 (Peer)
prompt:
A foreign friend of yours has recently graduated from college and intends to find a job in China. Write him/her an e-mail to make some suggestions.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name in the email; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
key_points: 祝贺对方毕业并引出为在华求职提建议的目的
建议制定清晰的职业规划并了解目标行业与企业
推荐专业求职招聘平台并提醒尽早办理工作签证
register_analysis: 写给刚毕业外国朋友的私人咨询信函，语域随和自然、亲切真诚。首段直接祝贺毕业切入，严禁自我介绍；次段用 it is crucial to / function as indispensable tools / strongly recommend 提出务实建议；尾段送上真挚祝愿。
vocabulary_benchmark: launch one's career, educational background, vacancy updates, post-study work visa, mandatory requirement, land one's dream job.
extractable_expressions: Congratulations on your graduation from college.
Hearing that you intend to [goal], I am pleased to share some suggestions that may contribute to [objective].
To begin with, it is crucial to [action] by taking [factors] into account.
Secondly, [resources] function as indispensable tools, enabling you to [benefit].
Moreover, I strongly recommend [action] as early as possible, since [reason].
official_model:
【版本一 · 高级范文】
Dear Jack,

Congratulations on your graduation from college. Hearing that you intend to launch your career in China, I am pleased to share some suggestions that may contribute to your job search.

To begin with, it is crucial to craft a clear career plan by taking your educational background, strengths and interests into account, based on which you can then collect information about your desired industries and companies. Secondly, a variety of recruitment websites, particularly those tailored for international job seekers in China, function as indispensable tools, enabling you to receive vacancy updates and submit your job applications efficiently. Moreover, I strongly recommend applying for a post-study work visa as early as possible, since it is a mandatory requirement for employment in China.

I hope my suggestions above would be of benefit to you. Wish you all the success in landing your dream job soon.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

【版本二 · 满分习作】
Dear Jack,

Heartfelt congratulations on graduating with honors. I am truly delighted to hear that you are now planning to embark on your career by seeking a job here in China, and I would like to share some specific advice.

First of all, it is wise to develop a personalized career plan through a comprehensive pre-application self-assessment. Second, you may need to polish your resume to highlight skills such as cross-cultural communication and adaptability, which are highly valued by Chinese employers. Moreover, I recommend leveraging international talent platforms and alumni networks for exclusive opportunities. Finally, please remember to initiate the process of applying for a post-study work visa as early as possible, since the procedure can take some time.

I hope these tips would be helpful to you. I am confident that you will find a job that matches your skills and aspirations.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

source_file: docs/英二小作文/2020英二小作文.md
relationship: 同侪群体/留学生同学 (Peer Group)
prompt:
Suppose you are planning a tour of a historical site for a group of international students. Write them an email to
1) tell them about the site, and
2) give them some tips for the tour.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name. Use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
key_points: 表明写信目的，交代选定的历史名胜古迹（兵马俑）
介绍古迹历史底蕴与壮丽看点
给出避开高峰、早起出行、租用多语言讲解器等实用建议
register_analysis: 面向留学生同学的出行建议与景点推荐，用语自然亲切、诚挚得体。重点在于将文化介绍与具象出行 Tips 结合，突出历史文化底蕴与实操价值。
vocabulary_benchmark: historical attraction, archaeological discoveries, life-size clay warriors, fascinating glimpse, glorious past, multilingual audio guide.
extractable_expressions: I am writing to inform you of the historical attraction to visit—[Site], one of the greatest [category] of all time—and share some travel tips.
Located to [location], [Site] is a massive collection of [features], offering a fascinating glimpse into [culture/history].
To get a better view of [attraction], you may consider [action].
In addition, it is also advisable to [action], which will certainly make your trip informative.
official_model:
Dear Friends,

    I am so delighted that you trust me to arrange your trip. I am writing to inform you of the historical attraction to visit—the Terracotta Army, one of the greatest archaeological discoveries of all time—and share some travel tips.

    Located to the east of downtown Xi'an, the Terracotta Army is a massive collection of life-size clay warriors and horses buried in the tomb of China's First Emperor. It offers a fascinating glimpse into the country's glorious past. To get a better view of these breathtaking sculptures, you may consider avoiding public holidays in China or setting out early if you have to visit the museum on those days. In addition, it is also advisable to rent a multilingual audio guide at the ticket office, which will certainly make your trip informative.

    I hope you will enjoy this unforgettable cultural journey. Feel free to contact me if you need any further assistance.

Best regards,
Li Ming

source_file: docs/英二小作文/2012英二小作文.md
relationship: 消费者对客服部门 (Consumer to Business)
prompt:
Suppose you have found something wrong with the electronic dictionary that you bought from an online store the other day. Write an email to the customer service center to
1) make a complaint, and
2) demand a prompt solution.
You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use "Zhang Wei" instead.
Do not write the address. (10 points)
key_points: 交代网购电子词典信息并正式提出质量投诉
详细列举产品频繁关机、客服敷衍等故障事实
提出明确合理诉求（换全新机或全额退款）及解决期限
register_analysis: 商务维权投诉信，措辞严谨规范、不卑不亢，兼具交涉力量与礼貌素养。用事实说话，准确运用缺陷与诉求词汇，不作无理人身攻击。
vocabulary_benchmark: electronic dictionary, customer service center, lodge a complaint, prompt solution, erratic and persistent shutdowns, immediate replacement, full refund.
extractable_expressions: I am writing this email to lodge a formal complaint regarding [product] that I purchased from your online store on [date].
I had placed high trust in [company/brand]; nevertheless, this purchase has brought me severe frustration.
Upon receiving the parcel, I was dismayed to discover that [defect].
Under these circumstances, I feel fully justified in requesting an immediate replacement or a full refund.
official_model:
Dear Sir or Madam,

    I am writing this email to lodge a formal complaint regarding the electronic dictionary (Model P900 PRO) that I purchased from your online flagship store on November 6th.

    I had placed high trust in the quality of your products; nevertheless, this gadget has proved severely defective. Only two days after its arrival, the dictionary began to suffer from erratic and persistent automatic shutdowns, which caused severe inconvenience to my English studies. Furthermore, your online customer service representatives failed to provide any constructive solution when I inquired yesterday.

    Under these circumstances, I feel fully justified in demanding an immediate replacement with a brand-new device or a full refund. I expect your prompt settlement within three business days.

Yours faithfully,
Zhang Wei

source_file: docs/英二小作文/2018英二小作文.md
relationship: 学生对教授 (Student to Professor)
prompt:
Suppose you have to cancel your travel plan and will not be able to visit Professor Smith. Write him an email to
1) apologize and explain the situation, and
2) suggest a future meeting.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name. Use "Li Ming" instead.
Do not write your address. (10 points)
key_points: 开门见山说明无法如期拜访，诚恳致歉
客观解释突发流感遵医嘱静养的真实事由
表达遗憾并委婉提议重新约定下次会面时间
register_analysis: 学生致教授的半正式致歉信，用语礼貌得体、客气真诚，既体现对师长日程安排的敬重，又显自然得体。解释原因客观具体，补救举措周到。
vocabulary_benchmark: apologize for, necessitate changes, busy schedule, acute influenza, bed rest, cancel travel plan, rearrange the appointment.
extractable_expressions: I am writing to apologize for not being able to [event] as planned.
I am deeply sorry for any inconvenience it causes you and any changes it necessitates in your busy schedule.
Regrettably, [unforeseen event], leaving me little choice but to [action].
I was wondering whether we could rearrange the appointment at your earliest convenience.
official_model:
Dear Professor Smith,

    I am writing to apologize for not being able to visit you tomorrow as planned. I am deeply sorry for any inconvenience it causes you and any changes it necessitates in your busy schedule.

    I had been eagerly looking forward to our meeting; unexpectedly, I woke up with a high fever and severe headache this morning. After a clinic examination, I was diagnosed with acute influenza. The physician strongly advised me to take bed rest, leaving me little choice but to cancel my travel plan.

    It is truly regrettable that we cannot meet as scheduled. I was wondering whether we could rearrange the appointment for next week if your timetable allows. Please let me know when you will be available.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

relationship: 同侪好友 (Peer)
prompt:
Suppose you are organizing an online meeting. Write an e-mail to Jack, an international student, to
1) invite him to participate, and
2) tell him the details.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name. Use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
key_points: 以读书会组织者身份正式邀请 Jack 参加线上会议，明确时间与平台
介绍会议主题（分享本国著名作家及作品，促进跨文化交流）
说明会议具体安排及期待对方加入
register_analysis: 面向留学生同侪的活动邀请，语气亲切随和、诚挚得体。杜绝老派生硬官僚外交辞令（严禁对同学使用 favor us with a reply），采用现代同侪交流风格，结语使用 Best regards,。
vocabulary_benchmark: organizer, monthly reading session, online meeting, cross-cultural exchanges, broaden literary horizons, literature enthusiast, unique perspectives.
extractable_expressions: As an organizer of [activity], I am writing to invite you to our online meeting scheduled for [time] via [platform].
With the theme of [Theme], this gathering aims to expose participants to [field].
As a [role/identity], you are warmly invited to share your unique perspectives on [topic].
We would be thrilled if you could accept our invitation. Looking forward to our discussion.
official_model:
Dear Jack,

    As an organizer of our monthly reading session, I am writing to invite you to our online meeting scheduled for next Friday from 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. via Zoom.

    With the theme of 'A Famous Writer from Your Country', this gathering aims to expose participants to writers and works from diverse cultural backgrounds. Attendees will engage in cross-cultural discussions to broaden their literary horizons. As a passionate literature enthusiast, you are warmly invited to share your unique perspectives on contemporary fiction.

    Detailed meeting arrangements and the agenda link have been sent to your email. We would be thrilled if you could join us. Looking forward to our lively discussion.

Best regards,
Li Ming

source_file: docs/英二小作文/2010英二小作文.md
relationship: 跨文化同事/同侪 (Colleague / Peer)
prompt:
You have just come back from the U.S. as a member of a Sino-American cultural exchange program. Write a letter to your American colleague to
1) express your thanks for his/her warm reception;
2) welcome him/her to visit China in due course.
You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use "Zhang Wei" instead.
Do not write your address. (10 points)
key_points: 对文化交流期间美方同事的热情款待表达由衷感谢
深情回顾陪同参访与跨文化交流的温暖细节
热忱邀请对方适时访华并承诺担任向导
register_analysis: 跨文化同侪/同事间的致谢信，语气真诚亲切、谦逊得体，洋溢着开放包容的国际交流视野与深厚友谊。
vocabulary_benchmark: sincere gratitude, warm hospitality, generous assistance, cultural exchange program, cultural diversity, cherished memories, hospitable guide.
extractable_expressions: I would like to express my sincere gratitude to you for your warm hospitality and generous assistance during my recent visit to [place].
I can still recall vividly how you [action], which made my stay both rewarding and memorable.
Should you have the opportunity to visit China in due course, please do let me know so that I can serve as your guide and return your wonderful kindness.
Wish you health and happiness.
official_model:
Dear Jane,

    I would like to express my sincere gratitude to you for your warm hospitality and generous assistance during my recent visit to the United States as part of the cultural exchange program.

    I can still recall vividly how you accompanied me through university campuses and shared insightful perspectives on cultural diversity. Thanks to your thoughtful guidance, I was able to adapt smoothly to the local academic environment and gained profound insights into American higher education. This journey has left me with cherished memories.

    Should you have the opportunity to visit China in due course, please do let me know so that I can serve as your guide and return your wonderful kindness. Wish you health and happiness.

Best regards,
Zhang Wei

key_points: 说明获悉招聘信息并正式提出助教岗位申请
阐述专业学术成绩、英语专八资质及辅导经验

vocabulary_benchmark: position available, submit formal application, TEM-8, pedagogical competencies, peer tutor, interpersonal tact, enclosed resume, favorable review.
extractable_expressions: Having learned from [source] that [position] is currently available, I am writing with keen interest to submit my formal application.
Having achieved [qualification] and maintained an outstanding academic record, I possess solid [skills] competencies.
In addition, my prior experience as [role] has endowed me with exceptional patience and interpersonal tact.
Enclosed with this letter is my detailed resume for your review. I would genuinely appreciate the opportunity for an interview at your convenience.
official_model:
Dear Sir or Madam,

    Having learned from your official portal that an English Teaching Assistant position is currently available, I am writing with keen interest to submit my formal application.

    Having achieved a top-tier score in TEM-8 and maintained an outstanding academic record, I possess proficient bilingual fluency and solid pedagogical competencies. In addition, my prior one-year experience as a peer tutor has endowed me with exceptional patience and interpersonal tact, enabling me to communicate effectively with students from diverse backgrounds. I am fully confident in my capacity to assist your faculty in optimizing classroom efficiency.

    Enclosed with this letter is my detailed resume for your review. I would genuinely appreciate the opportunity for an interview at your convenience.

Yours faithfully,
Li Ming

source_file: docs/英一小作文/2023英一小作文.md
relationship: 发布单位对学生大众 (Host to Students)
prompt:
Write a notice to recruit a student for Prof. Smith’s research project on campus sports activities.
Specify the duties and requirements of the job.
Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name in the notice; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
key_points: 开篇直陈招募意图与史密斯教授体育研究项目背景
明确助手的岗位职责（问卷分发与数据录入分析）及资质要求
提供报名联系邮箱与截止日期，欢迎积极申请
register_analysis: 校内招募告示规范公文。标题 Notice 居中，无称呼，日期与落款位置规范，语言客观凝练，信息要素闭环齐备。
vocabulary_benchmark: research project, student assistant, campus sports activities, distribute questionnaires, preliminary statistical data entry, proficient communication skills, commit hours.
extractable_expressions: Professor Smith is currently seeking a student assistant for his research project on [subject], which aims to [goal].
The recruited assistant will primarily be responsible for [duty 1], as well as assisting in [duty 2].
Prospective candidates are expected to demonstrate proficient [skills] and [qualities].
Those who are interested are warmly encouraged to send their resumes to [email] prior to [date].
official_model:
【版本一 · 高级范文】
Notice

Professor Smith is currently looking for an assistant for his research project on campus sports activities, which aims to reveal factors affecting students’ sports preferences.

Once recruited, the assistant will be asked to distribute well-designed questionnaires to various student groups across campus and ensure their proper completion. After collecting sufficient raw data, the assistant will need to build a database based on them and carry out further analysis. Therefore, the prospective candidate is expected to demonstrate good communication and analytical skills. The research project lasts about a month, during which the assistant can receive an hourly wage of 40 yuan.

This is a great opportunity to gain valuable research experience. If the research project aligns with your academic interests, please do not hesitate to apply by sending your résumé to profsmith@uni.com.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

【版本二 · 满分习作】
Notice

Professor Smith’s research project on campus sports activities is now recruiting a student assistant. This project, lasting for approximately one month on our main campus, aims to explore students’ participation in and attitudes towards campus sports.

The main responsibilities include distributing and collecting questionnaires, assisting in data analysis, and conducting interviews with participants. To fit the position, the ideal candidate should be a detail-oriented individual with strong communication skills, proficiency in English and data analysis softwares, a strong sense of responsibility and teamwork spirit. Preference will be given to juniors, seniors, or graduate students who can commit at least 20 hours per week to this project.

If interested, please email your application form to 123@hotmail.com before April 3rd. Your enthusiasm for sports research is highly welcomed.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

relationship: 同侪留学生 (Peer Student)
prompt:
Read the following email from an international student and write a reply.

Dear Li Ming,
I've got a class assignment to make an oral report on an ancient Chinese scientist, but I'm not sure how to prepare for it. Can you give me some advice? Thank you for your help.
Yours,
Paul

Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name in your email; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
key_points: 友好回应求助，欣然表示愿意就口头报告准备提供建议
推荐具体科学家（李时珍），建议按生平背景、主要贡献与历史影响三段式组织

Suppose your cousin Li Ming has just been admitted to a university. Write him/her a letter to

key_points: 获悉喜讯，向李明考取知名学府致以最真诚的祝贺，盛赞其多年的刻苦奋斗终结硕果；
针对由高中向大学的转变提出中肯建议（及时收心调整状态，警惕自由时间过多导致松懈，养成自律习惯；尽早了解专业课程设置与培养方向，明晰未来发展道路；积极通过社交渠道联络同窗师长，融入集体校园活动）；
再次重申热烈祝贺，送上最美好的祝愿，期盼其度过充实难忘的大学岁月。

vocabulary_benchmark: admission to, prestigious university, embark on a new journey, get into a habit of, self-disciplined, slack off, gain exposure to, navigate career path, connect with, upperclassmen, stay informed about.
extractable_expressions: Congratulations on your admission to such a prestigious university.
As embarking on a new journey can be both exciting and challenging, you had better [action].
Try to get into a habit of [habit] first, or [negative consequence].
Moreover, it is never too early to gain exposure to [field], which will undoubtedly help you [benefit].
Besides, you are encouraged to connect with [people] on social media, so as to [objective].
official_model:
Dear Li Ming,

Congratulations on your admission to such a prestigious university. I am immensely thrilled that all your effort and perseverance over the years has paid off.

As embarking on a new journey can be both exciting and challenging, you had better get prepared for it after the celebration. Try to get into a habit of being self-disciplined first, or the sudden freedom of college life may easily lead you to slack off. Moreover, it is never too early to gain exposure to your major, which will undoubtedly help you better navigate your career path. Besides, you are encouraged to connect with your future classmates and upperclassmen on social media, so as to find like-minded friends and stay informed about upcoming campus events.

Anyway, congratulations again on your admission and wish you a fulfilling college life.

Yours sincerely,
Zhang Wei

具体介绍个人主要生活习惯（如规律早睡早起、饮食清淡偏好家常烹饪、注重公共区域整洁、尊重个人空间等）；

Dear John,

I am delighted to be your roommate during my time abroad. Before moving in, I would like to brief you about my living habits so that we can get acquainted with each other.

To be honest, I am a bit of a homebody, enjoying indoor activities, especially cooking. But there is no need to be concerned about the lingering smell of frying, as I stick to a light diet.

By the way, could you give me some tips on the local customs and etiquette, which will help me fit in with the life there? I am looking forward to your early reply.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

Li Ming

It would be much appreciated if you could offer me some advice on them.

Dear Professor Williams,

It is a great honor to be invited to deliver a presentation to international students. I am pleased to take this opportunity to share with them my knowledge of Chinese culture.

My presentation will focus on Chinese martial arts, one of the treasures of traditional Chinese culture. I would like to start with asking my audience how much they know about this tradition, before giving a brief overview of its origin and development over millennia. In the body of my speech, I will highlight some influential styles of Chinese martial arts and specify their unique fighting techniques and philosophical ideas. Sincerely yours,
Li Ming

I am full of anticipation for our survey on the protection of old houses in the ancient town nearby. To ensure it goes well, I would like to outline my plan.

relationship: 房客对房东/友人 (Guest to Host)
prompt:
You have just come back from Canada and found a music CD in your luggage that you forgot to return to Bob, your landlord there. Write him a letter to
1) make an apology, and
2) suggest a solution.
You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use "Li Ming" instead.
Do not write the address. (10 points)
key_points: 明确、简要地陈述感到抱歉的事。开头段应说明事情原委，指出自己因疏忽大意而误将唱片带走，并坦诚表达歉意，此时不宜把自己的过错归咎于别人；
提出解决办法。中间段应提出补救措施，比如快递邮寄唱片、付费给对方购买新唱片、约定下次见面时亲自归还等，可同时提出上述措施，由对方决定哪种办法合适；
再次向对方表达诚挚歉意，表明妥善解决问题的态度，期待对方回复。
register_analysis: 这是一封写给房东的私人道歉信，无需使用正式公文语体，应亲切自然，同时保持礼貌。承认错误时应避免使用勉强的语气，要用诚恳、礼貌、情愿的语气表达歉意；同时又由于题目涉及的是个人疏忽造成的小错，道歉态度真诚即可，不宜使用过分夸张、自责的表达以造成言过其实的感觉。。在答题卡2上整洁规范书写，篇幅在 100 词左右；严格按照书信格式撰写，明确说明事情原委、真诚致歉并提出切实可行的补救方案；信末不得署考生真实姓名，统一使用“Li Ming”；不得书写具体地址。
vocabulary_benchmark: warm hospitality, unintentional mistake, mistakenly packed, favorite music CD, deeply sorry for distress, immediately send back, registered mail, cherish fond memories.
extractable_expressions: I am writing to express my deepest gratitude for your hospitality and, more importantly, to apologize for an unintentional blunder.
Upon unpacking my luggage, I was shocked to find that I had mistakenly packed your [Item].
I am deeply sorry for any distress and inconvenience this careless mistake may have caused you.
I have already mailed it back via registered express post, and you should receive it within [Days].
Once again, please accept my heartfelt apologies, and I hope for your kind forgiveness.

Dear Bob,

My days in Canada would not have passed so merrily without your kindness and support. That is why I feel especially regretful about being so preoccupied with preparing for my journey home that I forgot to return the music CD you generously lent me. It was not until yesterday when I came back to Beijing that I suddenly found it while unpacking my suitcase.

To make up for my carelessness, I plan to mail it back through EMS at once. It is expected to reach you in about one week. Or, if you would like to listen to the songs sooner, perhaps you could buy another copy of the CD locally. I will be more than willing to pay for the new one while keeping the old one as a reminder of my time in Canada.

Once again, please accept my sincere apologies for any inconvenience this oversight may have caused you.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

relationship: 读者对报社编辑 (Reader to Editor)
prompt:
Restrictions on the use of plastic bags have not been so successful in some regions. "White Pollution" is still going on.
Write a letter to the editor(s) of your local newspaper to
1) give your opinions briefly, and
2) make two or three suggestions.
You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use "Li Ming" instead.
Do not write the address. (10 points)
key_points: 表明读者身份拉近心理距离，肯定报社在报道社会问题、弘扬环保理念方面的已有贡献；结合观察指出部分地区限塑令执行不力和白色污染依然存在的问题，表明写信意图以引起重视；
简要分析塑料污染的严重危害，并结合当地实际从多维度（如政府强化源头监管、社会各界与商家设立激励机制、研发推广环保替代品等）提出两至三条具体、合理、具备可操作性的对策与建议；
表达期许并呼吁环保，肯定报社的舆论引导力量，期待报社借助媒体公信力动员广大民众共同遵守限塑令、保护环境，并致以礼貌谢意。
register_analysis: 这是一封写给报社编辑的公务信函，属于正式文体。措辞应礼貌客气、严谨得体，既体现对报社工作的尊重，又传达真诚建设性的态度，避免过度随意或提出脱离报社职能的越界要求。。在答题卡2上整洁规范书写，篇幅在 100 词左右；严格以当地居民/忠实读者身份向报社编辑提出中肯意见与改进建议；信末不得署考生真实姓名，统一使用“Li Ming”；不得书写具体地址。
vocabulary_benchmark: restrictions on plastic bags, environmental protection, white pollution, reusable cloth bags, public awareness, punitive measures, biodegradable alternatives, sustainable development.
extractable_expressions: I am writing this letter to voice my thoughts regarding the ongoing campaign against [Issue].
Despite the initial regulations, the overuse of [Item] remains rampant in daily life.
To tackle this problem, the authorities should enforce stricter punitive measures against [Violations].
In addition, launching educational campaigns will help heighten public awareness of [Topic].
I sincerely hope my views will be shared with your readership.

【版本一 · 高级范文】
Dear Editor,

As a college student and your faithful reader, I always appreciate your insightful reports on significant social issues. I am now writing to express my deep concern over the abuse of plastic bags in some regions despite government restrictions, and to share a few suggestions to tackle this issue.

It is widely acknowledged that the use of plastic bags, which take centuries to decompose and are a major contributor to white pollution, should undoubtedly be further reduced. Possible solutions include strengthening government control over the production and circulation of plastic bags, as well as fostering community support for such restrictions. For example, customers ought to try their best to refrain from using plastic bags, and stores can incentivize this practice by offering small gifts or discounts. Designers may enhance the visual appeal and functionality of cloth bags in an effort to promote the use of such green alternatives to plastic bags.

Given the limited influence of individual efforts, I hope you could call on the general public to abide by the restrictions on plastic bags. Thank you for your consideration, looking forward to seeing your newspaper’s continued leadership in environmental discourse.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

【版本二 · 满分习作】
Dear Editor,

As a devoted reader deeply concerned about environmental sustainability, I am writing to express my grave concern over the persistent issue of “White Pollution” caused by the abuse of plastic bags. Despite existing regulations, many small businesses continue to provide plastic bags freely, undermining efforts to curb this environmental hazard. The urgency of this matter cannot be overstated, as plastic waste not only pollutes our ecosystems but also poses long-term threats to public health.

To address this challenge effectively, I urge your newspaper to take a leadership role. Investigative reporting could shed light on violations, prompting stricter enforcement; editorials and community campaigns could encourage readers to embrace reusable alternatives. By leveraging your platform’s influence, we can foster a collective shift toward sustainable practices.

I firmly believe that with your commitment to influential journalism, we can motivate public action and hold both businesses and policymakers accountable. Thank you for your dedication to this critical cause.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

extractable_expressions: As a devoted student of our university, I am writing this letter to offer some modest suggestions on enhancing students' reading habits.
Firstly, establishing convenient 24-hour study spaces will cater to students' nighttime reading demands.
Secondly, organizing regular book reviews and scholarly discussions can stimulate intellectual curiosity.
Furthermore, expanding the availability of electronic reading resources will greatly facilitate access to academic literature.
Thank you for your time and attention to this matter.

I am writing out of deep concern for the weak constitution of many college students nowadays, including my schoolmates. Given the urgency of this matter, I respectfully submit the following recommendations.

To begin with, might the university consider establishing an outdoor fitness zone equipped with essential sports facilities adjacent to our dormitories? It would significantly lower the threshold for exercise, enabling students to incorporate physical activity seamlessly into their daily routines. Moreover, it would be highly advantageous if the university could offer diverse PE electives and organize fun sporting events, which would effectively stimulate students' enthusiasm for sports. Above all, it is perhaps imperative to hold a series of lectures on how regular exercise strengthens immunity and prevents lifestyle diseases. Such initiatives would naturally encourage greater participation in and even a lifelong habit of physical exercise.

Thank you for taking time from your busy schedule to review my proposals. I stand ready to provide further details should you wish to explore these suggestions.

key_points: - 第一部分：表明推荐意图。开篇段直接交代写作目的（即将举办读书会活动，特此推荐一本书），并点明书籍的核心信息，如名称、体裁、题材及作者；
- 第二部分：详细说明推荐理由。主体段分层阐述所推荐书籍的独特性或魅力所在，推荐理由应积极正面、易于被读者接受，可从正面论证思想性与艺术性，也可从侧面援引销量好评等，切忌泛泛而谈；

Penned by [Author], this literary classic presents a poignant critique of [Theme].

relationship: 项目协调人对志愿者朋友 (Project Coordinator to Volunteer Friend)
prompt:
Suppose you are working for the "Aiding Rural Primary Schools" project of your university. Write an email to answer the inquiry from an international student volunteer, specifying the details of the project.

You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name in the email; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)

围绕留学生志愿者关切的问题展开说明，包括项目时间、地点、宗旨（增加当地学生接触英语机会、促进文化交流等）、参与者职责（教授英语、协助当地教师等）以及费用情况等，条理清晰、信息完整；

extractable_expressions: I am thrilled to receive your inquiry regarding our Aiding Rural Primary Schools volunteer teaching program.
Your enthusiasm for supporting education in rural areas is deeply appreciated.
As a volunteer teacher, you will primarily be responsible for teaching basic English courses and organizing extracurricular games.
Though the living conditions in the village are modest, local teachers and villagers are exceedingly warm-hearted.

With sincere appreciation for your enthusiasm for our project, “Aiding Rural Primary Schools”, I would like to answer your inquiry and provide key details regarding the forthcoming voluntary activity.

Each summer holiday, we organize this project, where ten qualified volunteers are recruited to teach English in a rural primary school for a month. The program primarily focuses on delivering interactive English lessons, specially designed for rural Chinese pupils to speak English confidently and naturally, even with limited vocabulary. In case you worry about your lack of experience and have a sense of inadequacy, there will be a brief training session to get you fully prepared before embarking on this challenging yet exciting journey. As for the expenses, we will cover all the costs for meals, accommodation and transportation.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

Sincerely yours,
Li Ming

We are openly soliciting exhibits from all students, including calligraphy works, traditional paintings, paper-cuttings, and handcrafted artifacts.
All submitted entries should represent authentic cultural characteristics and be in well-preserved condition.
Selected pieces will be exhibited abroad, and certificates of honor will be conferred upon the creators.
Please deliver your exhibits to Room 102 of the Student Activity Center by [Date].

The contest will take place from [Time] to [Time] on [Date] in the University Hall.

Dear Professor Smith,

The annual International Innovation Contest organized by my university is scheduled for October 24th to 30th. On behalf of the organizing committee, I would like to extend to you and your students an invitation to take part in this contest.

Aimed at raising the awareness of approaching real-world problems in innovative ways among the younger generation, this year’s contest will be on the theme of Innovating Urban Waste Management. Each team of up to four participants will brainstorm to formulate a detailed proposal for urban waste disposal and recycling. The independent jury will assess the originality and practicality of the proposals submitted before selecting five prize-winning ones. The winning teams will be awarded certificates and funding for project implementation. At the cutting edge of research on urban planning, you and your students may provide enlightening and even groundbreaking insights into sustainable waste management. Moreover, over 15 teams from prestigious universities around the globe have so far confirmed their entry into the contest. It is bound to be rewarding to exchange ideas with them.

It would be greatly appreciated if you could inform me of your decision by replying to this email before September 25th. We would be delighted to have you and your team participate in the event. For any further information, please feel free to contact me.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

We would be honored to have your team participate in this important event. Kindly confirm your participation by November 5th. Should you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me at aginginnovation@university.edu.com.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

The young craftsmen we would invite are experts in blending traditional crafts with modern design. Dear Paul,

Your keen interest in our upcoming Innovative Craftsmanship Demonstration is truly encouraging. I am more than delighted to share its highlights with you.

The invited young craftsmen are bringing a dynamic fusion of tradition and innovation—the contemporary interpretations of intangible cultural heritage, which integrate paper-cutting, pottery-making, and embroidery into the design of everyday ornaments. In addition, there will be a hands-on zone where they will guide students to try basic techniques such as pottery-molding. For preparations, you are a perfect fit for pre-event promotion: design eye-catching theme posters, put them up across campus, and hand out flyers to draw more students' attention. Your expertise and creativity will surely maximize the impact of these efforts.

This event is not just about spreading the charm of traditional crafts; it is a chance to breathe new life into cultural inheritance through innovation. Together, we can make it an unforgettable success.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
